description: Validate a listing manifest and save it as a draft you own. Steps run in order: fetch, parse, filter, dedupe, transform (sandboxed JavaScript or Python with no network access) and map_entity. Returns the draft id and manifest_hash. Invalid manifests return 422 with the field errors. Test the draft with alterlab_listing_draft_test, then publish with alterlab_listing_publish. Needs an API key with the listings:write scope.
